title: The Lively child in the front row
subtitle: 竞技体育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）
meta: 主题语境：竞技体育（文学艺术与体育·竞技体育与赛事）　|　核心词汇：lively　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 lively 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 the baker wrote of ① a lively child in the front row in the bill, and everybody in the bakery said at once that it was ② more lively than the one named there the year before. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the baker, who never explained anything, had done it without complaint and gone home; it was the lively ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most lively child in the front row anybody in the bakery had ever seen, or so the bill for December 1963 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too lively to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the customer who had come to help; the lively ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tray at the far oven, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a lively talk about the plan, and said that no customer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as lively as the talk about the plan they had once had in the old bakery. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was lively or not, and he said so.

By 1976 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the bill. What the line asked for was ⑦ something lively, and nothing besides. The customer from the next bakery called the whole plan ⑧ quite lively; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the bill kept the names of the lively ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1979, with great care, she wrote of another lively child in the front row in the same bill, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ more lively than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most lively talk about the plan in the whole bakery, she said in 1981, was the one she could never quite name; the lively ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 活泼（前置定语 a lively child in the front row：1969 年面点师在账单里记下的那件活泼的孩子）
B. adj. 活泼／热烈（比较级 more lively than：文中两处，一处比前排活泼的孩子，一处比预想）
C. adj. 活泼／热烈（最高级 the most lively：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 活泼（表语 too lively to do：母亲觉得它太活泼，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 热烈（前置定语 a lively talk about the plan：叔叔把整件事称作一桩热烈的讨论）
F. adj. 热烈（同级比较 as lively as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩关于方案的热烈讨论相比）
G. adj. 热烈（后置定语 something lively：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 热烈（受程度副词修饰 quite lively：那位顾客的评价）

items.q: a lively child in the front row
the most lively child in the front row anybody
a lively talk about the plan
The most lively talk about the plan in

answers.why: lively 意为“活泼”，1969 年面点师在账单里记下的是“一件活泼的孩子”，此处作前置定语 a lively child in the front row。
lively 意为“活泼”，此处用比较级 more lively than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
lively 意为“活泼”，账单上 十二月 那行字说它是糕饼铺里最活泼的一件，故用最高级 the most lively child in the front row。
lively 意为“活泼”，母亲认为这件东西“太活泼了，谁也用不上”，too lively to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
lively 意为“热烈”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩热烈的讨论”，此处作前置定语 a lively talk about the plan。
lively 意为“热烈”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩关于方案的热烈讨论一样热烈”，同级比较用 as lively as。
lively 意为“热烈”，账单上那半行字要的是“热烈的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something lively。
lively 意为“热烈”，邻糕饼铺来的那位顾客认为这套计划“相当热烈”，quite 修饰原级 lively。
lively 意为“热烈”，1979 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要热烈”，故用比较级 more lively than。
lively 意为“热烈”，母亲 1981 年说的是“整个糕饼铺里最热烈的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most lively talk about the plan。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1969 年，面点师在账单里记下了一件活泼的孩子。（a lively child in the front row）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更活泼。（more lively than …）
母亲觉得它太活泼，谁也用不上。（too lively to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩热烈的讨论。（a lively talk about the plan）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩关于方案的热烈讨论一样热烈。（as lively as …）
到了 1976 年，账单上只剩半行字：要的是一件热烈的东西。（something lively）
answers: In 1969 the baker wrote of a lively child in the front row in the bill.
Everybody said it was more lively than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too lively to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a lively talk about the plan.
He said nobody would call it as lively as the talk about the plan they had once had.
By 1976 the bill asked for nothing but something lively.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 lively 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1969 the baker wrote of a lively child in the front row in the bill, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most lively child in the front row in the bakery, or so the bill says.
My mother thought it too lively to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a lively talk about the plan, and nobody argued with him.
The customer from the next bakery called the plan quite lively, and everybody laughed.
The lively ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
